nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure function that computes c = a + b and requires c >= a to guard against overflow.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure function that requires b <= a and returns c = a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure function that computes c = a * b and requires a == 0 || c / a == b.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure function that requires b > 0 and returns c = a / b.

onlyOwner function that stages a pending owner in newOwner.

Constant function returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] without safe subtraction.
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Public function moving tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emitting Transfer.
Public function writing allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emitting Approval.
Public function moving tokens from 'from' to 'to', decrementing allowed[from][msg.sender] with safeSub.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Public function that sets allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval with arbitrary data.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, refusing ETH.
onlyOwner function performing an external ERC20 transfer call to an arbitrary tokenAddress.
Untrusted caller-supplied address used for ownership, authentication and balance ownership.
Arithmetic addition c = a + b executed inside SafeMath.safeAdd.
Arithmetic subtraction c = a - b executed inside SafeMath.safeSub.
Arithmetic multiplication c = a * b executed inside SafeMath.safeMul.
Arithmetic division c = a / b executed inside SafeMath.safeDiv.
Balance mutation in transfer: debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[to] through SafeMath.
State mutation in transferFrom: debits balances[from], decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits balances[to].
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed after allowance state change.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an owner-controlled arbitrary address.
Unconditional revert() in the payable fallback, rejecting all incoming ETH.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, giving the caller privileged state.
acceptOwnership gates the ownership transfer on require(msg.sender == newOwner).
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], i.e. the caller's own balance.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller as the allowance owner.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender], so the caller identity determines spender authorization.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the external callee.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before executing transferAnyERC20Token.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner as the authorization source for the ownership change.
transferOwnership stores the caller-supplied _newOwner into the newOwner state variable.
The pending owner written by transferOwnership is later consumed by acceptOwnership.
The user-supplied tokens amount drives the balance arithmetic inside transfer.
transfer passes the untrusted token amount to SafeMath.safeAdd.
transfer state mutation writes the updated values into the balances mapping.
transferFrom uses the untrusted tokens amount in balance and allowance arithmetic.
transferFrom state mutation writes updated values into the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping entry for from/spender.
approve writes the caller-supplied tokens value into the allowance record.
approve stores the tokens amount in the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall forwards the token amount to an external contract before returning, enabling reentrant state observation.
Attacker-controlled bytes data is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
The spender address parameter selects the external contract target invoked by approveAndCall.
The arbitrary tokenAddress parameter is used for the outbound ERC20 transfer call.
The tokens amount parameter is passed to the external ERC20 transfer call.
The external call result is captured in the success return variable.
Parameter a is the first operand of the addition inside safeAdd.
Parameter b is the second operand of the addition inside safeAdd.
The addition result is stored into the local return variable c.
Parameter a is the first operand of the subtraction inside safeSub.
Parameter b is the second operand of the subtraction inside safeSub.
The subtraction result is stored into the local return variable c.
Parameter a is the first operand of the multiplication inside safeMul.
Parameter b is the second operand of the multiplication inside safeMul.
The multiplication result is stored into the local return variable c.
Parameter a is the numerator of the division inside safeDiv.
Parameter b is the denominator of the division inside safeDiv.
The division result is stored into the local return variable c.
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
balanceOf copies the mapping read into the named return variable balance.
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the outer allowed mapping in allowance.
The spender parameter indexes the inner allowed mapping in allowance.

The 'to' parameter is the credit destination of the transfer balance update.
The 'from' parameter is the debit source of the transferFrom balance update.
The 'to' parameter is the credit destination of the transferFrom balance update.
The external call success flag is returned by transferAnyERC20Token.
transfer invokes SafeMath.safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer invokes SafeMath.safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath.safeSub for both balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath.safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
approveAndCall executes the external receiveApproval call after the allowance write.
transferAnyERC20Token executes the outbound ERC20 transfer call.
transfer performs the balance arithmetic state update.
transferFrom performs the balance and allowance arithmetic state updates.

safeAdd executes the raw addition operation.
safeSub executes the raw subtraction operation.

The KVCToken constructor assigns the total supply value.
The KVCToken constructor pre-mints the entire supply into the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply in an unchecked subtraction.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] without SafeMath protection.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed mapping.
